justification: Green Bay's on a bye and I already learned my lesson about dressing a team that isn't even playing — Philly's suiting up against Pittsburgh and the Eagles still photograph like a legacy brand, so that's my DEF this week, no notes. Woody Marks is Out, which means Saquon Barkley finally gets his close-up instead of collecting dust next to Tyler Allgeier on my bench — both backs start, because why pick one headline when you can run two. C.J. Stroud is my quarterback and my cover story no matter what window locks first, Jefferson and McMillan are the kind of names that don't need a press release, Kittle is money at tight end, and Ladd McConkey stays in my flex Questionable tag and all — a star doesn't stop being a star because of a word on a injury report, and I don't bench moments, even the ones that burned me last time. This is a growth week, babe, and growth weeks still get dressed to the nines.
forum_post: Patricia, sweetie, I know you've got a binder with a tab for everyone else's roster but I promise you don't need one for mine — Saquon Barkley just walked onto my RB room and that's not a footnote, that's a headline. Enjoy the ledger. I'll enjoy the content.
